title: Debt to Income Ratio Calculator - DTI Guide 2024
excerpt: Calculate your debt to income ratio instantly. Learn what lenders look for and how to improve your DTI for better loan approval.
content:
Your debt-to-income ratio (DTI) is one of the most important numbers lenders use to decide if you qualify for a loan.

## What is DTI?

DTI compares your monthly debt payments to your gross monthly income. The formula is:

**DTI = (Monthly Debt Payments / Gross Monthly Income) × 100**

## Ideal DTI for Loans

- **28/36 Rule:** Housing should be ≤28% of income, total debts ≤36%
- **Conventional loans:** Typically want DTI under 36%
- **FHA loans:** Can accept DTI up to 43%

## How to Improve Your DTI

1. Pay down existing debts
2. Increase your income
3. Avoid taking on new debts
4. Consolidate high-interest debts

Use our free calculators to plan your debt payoff strategy.
